findings.source: Official Clerk Roll Call 322, https://clerk.house.gov/evs/2025/roll322; captured source referenced at logs/cron20261020T1800Z_case0493/roll322.receipt.json
findings.fact: H.Res.939 impeachment resolution roll call asked “On Motion to Table”; motion passed 237-140, 47 present, 9 not voting. This establishes that procedural vote, not passage of articles.
findings.limit: No later H.Res.939 status independently obtained in this follow-up.

findings.fact: Page note says a new Congress begins at noon Jan 3 of each odd-numbered year after general election, unless it designates another date by law. Thus Nov election day is not itself the listed new-Congress start date; Jan 3, 2027 is the general-rule date for the next Congress.
findings.limit: Generic explanatory note, not a separately verified 2027 House calendar or check for a different designation by law.

search_coverage: Direct official Congress.gov GETs for the H.Res.939 record and a 119th-Congress “impeach Trump” legislation search both returned HTTP 403 challenge pages. Therefore this follow-up does not establish current H.Res.939 legislative status, whether newer 2026 articles were introduced, whether any qualifying passage occurred, or universal absence. Do not infer those facts from the blocked search.
scope: No probability, rank, verdict, ledger change, or action.
